attchmntText: Beardsell Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
voiceSummary: Beardsell Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Statutory auditors G Balu Associates LLP issued unmodified limited review reports on standalone and consolidated results. The Board also approved proposals for factory modernization and expansion at the Karad facility in Maharashtra. The project involves an estimated capital expenditure of Rs. 24 Crores, financed through a combination of debt and internal accruals. The existing capacity is around 240,000 square meters per annum. The proposed capacity aims for 600,000 square meters per annum at full utilization. The new capacity is targeted to be added by 31 March 2027. The board meeting concluded at 2:00 p.m. on 14 November 2026.

attchmntText: Beardsell Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
